subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 3 updates

question: Should this PR be merged only after a maintainer obtains redacted live workflow output for the updated CodeQL and stale actions, or is the existing successful CI evidence sufficient for this dependency update?
rationale: The patch is mechanically narrow, but it changes executable third-party CI actions and the bot author cannot supply the required real-environment proof without maintainer involvement.

options.title: Capture a live workflow run
options.body: Run the updated CodeQL and stale workflows or capture their redacted logs, then merge once the observed behavior matches the existing policy.

options.title: Accept CI-only evidence
options.body: Merge based on the clean diff and successful checks while explicitly accepting that no live workflow output was reviewed.

recommendation.title: Capture a live workflow run
